info.title: MaxAPI API reference
info.description:
Access text, image, and audio models through a unified API. Select an endpoint to inspect request parameters, response structures, and code examples, then send a request from the interactive playground.

**Make your first request**: Create an API key in the [console](https://platform.maxapi.ai), enter it in the authentication field, and replace `YOUR_MODEL_ID` with a model available to your account that supports the endpoint. The SDK base URL is `https://api.maxapi.ai/v1`.

[Quickstart](/en/quickstart) · [Authentication](/en/authentication) · [Models and capabilities](/en/models) · [Error handling](/en/help/errors)

This reference covers 9 common compatible endpoints. Optional parameters, input limits, and model capabilities depend on your account channels. Example content and usage values illustrate response structures. For asynchronous APIs, see [Video generation](/en/media/videos), [Music generation](/en/media/music), and [Asynchronous tasks](/en/guides/async-tasks).

Changing the documentation language changes explanations and example text. API paths, parameter names, and enum values stay the same.

post.description:
Generate the next response from a message list for chat, summarization, translation, or code generation.

- Read non-streaming text from `choices[].message.content`.
- With `stream: true`, read SSE text deltas from `choices[].delta.content`.
- Image messages and function tools require model support. Include the conversation history in `messages` for each turn.

[Streaming](/en/guides/streaming) · [Vision](/en/guides/vision) · [Tool calling](/en/guides/tools)

200.description: Returns JSON for non-streaming requests or SSE when stream is true.

message.content: An API is an interface that applications use to exchange information.

schema.description: An SSE stream with events separated by blank lines. data: [DONE] marks the end. Chat text deltas are in choices[].delta.content; completion text is in choices[].text. See [Streaming](/en/guides/streaming).

stream.description: Separate complete events by blank lines, then parse each data field. A network read does not necessarily contain one complete event.

messages.content: Explain what an API is in three sentences.

tools.description: Requires a model that supports tool calling. The model returns a call request; your application executes the tool.

post.description:
Continue text from a `prompt` in applications that use the legacy Completions API. Select a model that supports this endpoint.

Read text from `choices[].text` in both non-streaming and streaming responses. For chat, use the chat completions endpoint with `messages`.

200.description: Returns JSON for non-streaming requests. Streaming text deltas are in choices[].text.

post.description:
Encode one or more texts as vectors for semantic search, similarity matching, and knowledge bases.

Use `data[].index` to match the input order. Use the same model and dimensions for documents and queries; rebuild the index when changing models.

200.description: Vectors for each input and usage information when available.

vectors.description: Only three illustrative values are shown. They do not represent actual model dimensions or usage.

input: How do I create an API key?
How do I list available models?

post.description:
Generate images from a text description. Start with only `model` and `prompt`, then set size, count, and quality according to model capabilities.

Results are in the `data` array as `url` or `b64_json`, depending on the model and requested format.

200.description: Image URLs or Base64 data, depending on the model and request.

base64.description: BASE64_IMAGE_DATA is a placeholder for image data. Some models return a url field instead.

value.prompt: A minimalist studio in the morning, a white desk lamp on the table, natural light, clean product photography composition

post.description:
Upload a source image and describe the changes. This definition accepts one image; masks require model support.

Upload file contents using `multipart/form-data` and let the client set the boundary. A file path string cannot replace a file upload.

200.description: The edited image as a URL or Base64 data.

base64.description: BASE64_IMAGE_DATA is a placeholder for image data. Some models return a url field instead.

basic.description: The model ID is a placeholder. Prepare the local file before running the code, or use the file picker when sending a request in the playground.

value.prompt: Keep the subject unchanged and replace the background with a light gray studio backdrop.

post.description:
Synthesize text into audio. Set a voice ID supported by the selected model and replace `YOUR_VOICE_ID` in the example.

A successful response contains audio bytes, with `Content-Type` determined by the output format. Check the HTTP status before saving or playing the result; errors may return JSON.

200.description: Binary audio content. Content-Type depends on the output format.

value.input: Welcome to MaxAPI. Start building your AI application.

basic.description: Replace the model and voice placeholders. MP3 output requires model support.

post.description:
Upload audio to transcribe it in its original language. Optionally provide an input language hint with `language`; the output depends on `response_format` and model capabilities.

Upload the file contents and let the client generate the multipart boundary. For JSON, read `text`; for text or subtitles, save the response body directly.

200.description: Returns text, JSON, or subtitles according to response_format.

For other target languages, transcribe the audio first, then translate the text with chat completions. File, model, and output format limits depend on your current channel.

get.description:
List the models visible to your API key, then use `data[].id` as the `model` parameter in other endpoints. This endpoint has no request body.

Visibility does not imply support for every endpoint, input type, or optional parameter. Account permissions and model status may change; use the current response as your reference.

[Models and capabilities](/en/models)

200.description: Models visible to the current API key.

models.description: YOUR_MODEL_ID is a placeholder. Use the exact ID returned in a current response.

BearerAuth.description: Create an API key in the [MaxAPI console](https://platform.maxapi.ai). Enter only the key in the authentication field; the client generates the `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_MAXAPI_API_KEY` header.

Error.description: The request failed. For 400, check parameters; for 401, check the key; for 403, check access permissions; for 429, check usage and rate limits; for 5xx, check service or upstream errors. Actual status codes and error bodies vary. See [Error handling](/en/help/errors).

error.message: The request could not be validated. Check your API key and request parameters.

error.description: This illustrates a compatible error body, not a complete error code specification.

ModelID.description: A model ID available to your account that supports this endpoint. Call GET /v1/models for exact IDs; visibility does not imply support for all endpoints or parameters. Replace the `YOUR_MODEL_ID` placeholder.

code.description: The error code; its type depends on the service response.

param.description: The request parameter associated with the error; may be null.

Error.description: A common compatible error structure. Upstream channels may return different fields. Check the HTTP status before reading error details.

completion_tokens.description: Number of output tokens, when applicable.

Usage.description: Token usage reported by the endpoint. Fields vary by model; consult the console for billing.

data.description: Models visible to the current API key.

role.description: The message role, such as system, user, assistant, developer, or tool. Use roles supported by the model.

content.description: Use a string for plain text or an array of text and image content parts for vision input. An assistant message with tool calls may have null content.

oneOf.example: Explain what an API is in three sentences.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls requested by the assistant. Preserve the complete structure when continuing the conversation.

tool_call_id.description: The corresponding tool call ID when role is tool.

ChatMessage.description: A conversation message. Submit history in order for multi-turn conversations and associate tool results with the original call ID.

messages.description: Messages in chronological order. Include the required conversation history for each turn.

stream.description: Returns an SSE stream when true. Parse data as complete events.

temperature.description: Sampling randomness. Support and accepted ranges depend on the model.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Usually adjust either this or temperature, not both.

max_tokens.description: The output token limit used by some models. Do not set together with max_completion_tokens.

max_completion_tokens.description: The generated token limit used by some models; it may include reasoning tokens.

stop.description: Stops generation when these sequences occur. Not supported by every model.

n.description: Number of candidate responses. Support and limits depend on the model.

presence_penalty.description: A sampling penalty for tokens that have already appeared. Requires model support.

frequency_penalty.description: Adjusts sampling according to token frequency. Requires model support.

tools.description: Tools the model may use for this request. Requires model support.

tool_choice.description: Controls tool selection. The common auto value lets the model choose; other string or object policies require model support.

ChatRequest.description: Start with only model and messages. Add optional parameters after confirming model support. Do not set max_tokens and max_completion_tokens together.

ChatResponse.description: A non-streaming chat result. Read text from choices[].message.content and tool calls from choices[].message.tool_calls.

prompt.description: Text to complete. Batch input requires model support.
prompt.example: Continue this introduction: MaxAPI helps developers

stream.description: Returns an SSE stream when true, with text deltas in choices[].text.

max_tokens.description: Output token limit. Requires model support.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Usually adjust either this or temperature.

n.description: Number of candidate results per input. Requires model support.

stop.description: Stops generation when these sequences occur. Not supported by every model.

logprobs.description: Requests token log probabilities. Requires model support.

CompletionRequest.description: The legacy Completions endpoint uses prompt rather than chat messages. This definition covers text input; token ID input requires model support.

text.description: The generated completion, or the current text delta in a streaming event.

finish_reason.description: The reason generation ended, such as stop or length.

input.description: A text string or a non-empty list of text strings. This definition covers text input; token ID input requires model support. Text length and batch limits depend on the model.

encoding_format.description: The embedding encoding format. Requires model support.

dimensions.description: The output dimensions, for models that support configurable dimensions.

index.description: The input index corresponding to this embedding.

embedding.description: An array of floating-point values or Base64 data, depending on the requested format.

EmbeddingResponse.description: An embedding response structure. Match input order with data[].index. Dimensions depend on the model and request parameters.

prompt.description: The image subject, setting, composition, and style.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Accepted values depend on the model.

size.description: The output dimensions. Requires model support.

quality.description: The quality level. Requires model support.

response_format.description: Some models allow url or b64_json; others use a fixed response format.

image.description: The image file contents. Format, dimensions, and file size limits depend on the model. The client generates the multipart boundary.

prompt.description: Editing instructions, including what to preserve.
prompt.example: Keep the subject unchanged and replace the background with a light gray studio backdrop.

mask.description: An optional PNG mask with transparent areas marking where to edit. Requires a model that supports masks.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Requires model support.

size.description: The output dimensions. Requires model support.

response_format.description: The output format. Requires model support.

url.description: A download URL for the generated image. It may expire; save the file when needed.

revised_prompt.description: A revised prompt, returned by some models.

data.description: Generated images. URL or Base64 output depends on the model and response_format.

input.description: Text to synthesize. Length limits depend on the model.

voice.description: A voice ID supported by the selected model. Replace YOUR_VOICE_ID with a confirmed supported voice.

response_format.description: An audio format supported by the model, such as mp3, opus, aac, or flac.

speed.description: Speech speed. Accepted ranges depend on the model.

file.description: Upload the file contents. Format, file size, and duration limits depend on the selected model.

language.description: An optional ISO 639-1 code for the input language, such as zh or en.

prompt.description: An optional terminology, style, or context hint in the original language.

response_format.description: An output format supported by the model, such as json, text, srt, verbose_json, or vtt.

file.description: Upload the file contents. Format, file size, and duration limits depend on the selected model.

prompt.description: An optional context hint in English. This endpoint outputs English; language cannot select an arbitrary target language.

response_format.description: An output format supported by the model, such as json, text, srt, verbose_json, or vtt.

text.description: The transcribed or translated text. Formats such as verbose_json may return additional fields.

AudioTextResponse.description: A JSON transcription or translation result. Formats such as verbose_json may include segments and timestamps; fields depend on the model.

id.description: The exact model ID to use in requests.

Model.description: A model visible to the current API key. May include additional metadata.

text.description: Text from the user, or a question about an image.

TextContentPart.description: The text part of a multimodal message.

url.description: An image URL directly accessible to the API server, or a complete data:image/...;base64,... URL. Local paths and pages that require login are not supported.

detail.description: The image detail level. Requires model support.

ImageContentPart.description: The image part of a multimodal message. Requires a model that supports vision input.

id.description: The tool call ID. Set tool_call_id to this value when submitting the tool result.

name.description: The function your application should execute.

arguments.description: Function arguments encoded as a JSON string. Your application parses and validates them before execution. For streaming, assemble all fragments first.

ToolCall.description: A function call requested by the model. Your application performs execution and permission checks.

type.description: This definition describes a function tool.

name.description: A function name recognized by your application.

description.description: Describe the purpose and use cases to help the model select the tool.

parameters.description: The JSON Schema for function parameters. Validate the arguments returned by the model in your application.

FunctionTool.description: A function definition available to the model. See [Tool calling](/en/guides/tools).

content.description: The generated text; may be null when the message contains tool calls.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls requested by the model. After execution, append result messages with role set to tool.

AssistantMessage.description: The complete assistant message from a non-streaming response.

index.description: The candidate response index in choices.

finish_reason.description: Why generation ended. Common values: stop for normal completion, length when a limit is reached, and tool_calls when tool results are needed.
